notice: All organizations, inputs, activity and results are synthetic. This proposed workflow is not a connected employer system or measured company performance.
title: Give the reviewer a concrete proposal and a verifiable outcome.
intro: A proposed GTM engineering workbench for CharacterQuilt: connect buying signals to a specific campaign bottleneck, an inspectable proposal and an execution-proof plan.
queueIntro: All accounts, campaigns and approvals are synthetic. This local portfolio never opens a customer tool, launches a campaign, changes an ad budget or sends a message.
workbenchIntro: Inspect the intended audience, asset, destination and evidence. The approval checkbox models a fictional review state and grants no real permission.
firstBuild: A distribution play with proof at every handoff
firstBody: Start with one customer bottleneck, prepare the exact campaign proposal, check destination state and define the evidence that would confirm completion.

fields.label: Buying signal has a dated source
Campaign bottleneck and target user defined
Named reviewer has approved the exact proposal in the scenario
Destination and existing campaign state checked
Outcome verification and recovery plan defined

rules.title: Ground the distribution signal
rules.next: Connect a real business event to a credible marketing-operations question rather than invented intent.

rules.title: Name the customer’s execution bottleneck
rules.next: Identify the coordination or tool-handoff problem worth demonstrating instead of promising broad autonomous marketing.

rules.title: Prepare the actual proposal
rules.next: The reviewer needs the intended audience, asset, destination and next action before approving a campaign.

rules.title: Keep the proposal awaiting review
rules.next: A generic instruction or earlier version does not approve a changed audience, asset or destination.

rules.title: Reconcile the destination state
rules.next: Check whether the intended campaign or action already exists before proposing another execution.

rules.title: Define the proof of execution
rules.next: Record what successful completion looks like and how uncertain or partial outcomes will be inspected before retry.

ready.title: Ready for a simulated execution review
ready.next: The proposal and verification plan can be inspected. This portfolio only records a local review receipt; no campaign is executed.

experiments.name: Concrete proposals before agent action
experiments.hypothesis: A reviewable audience, asset and destination reduces execution ambiguity.
experiments.guardrail: Changed scope after approval and missing destination context
experiments.allocation: Use matched account cohorts and a fixed observation window. Review uncertainty and selection effects before expansion.

experiments.name: Proof before retry
experiments.hypothesis: Checking the original outcome prevents duplicate campaign actions.
experiments.treatment: Inspect destination state and recorded evidence
experiments.allocation: Use matched account cohorts and a fixed observation window. Review uncertainty and selection effects before expansion.

roadmap.title: Choose a real distribution bottleneck
roadmap.body: Work with the founder and customers to identify a narrow campaign workflow and its commercial success measure.
roadmap.measure: Clear user, target action and baseline

roadmap.title: Build a proposal-and-proof loop
roadmap.body: Connect research and scoring to a reviewable campaign proposal. Test missing approval, changed state and uncertain outcomes.
roadmap.measure: Correct review behavior and reconstructable outcomes

roadmap.title: Turn the useful play into a reusable system
roadmap.body: Instrument qualified pipeline and execution quality. Document scope, failures and customer feedback before expanding.

metricsTitle: Execution quality is part of the commercial result.
metricsIntro: Synthetic campaign-proposal ledger separates review from execution claims.
metricsNotes: The counts are invented and do not describe CharacterQuilt’s production agents.
A local review receipt is not proof that an external campaign was launched.
Commercial measurement should connect a verified action to qualified outcomes, not count attempted clicks as completion.
